title: Rethinking Multi-Branch and Cross-Backbone Fusion for Vehicle Re-Identification under Foundation-Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2607.22068v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-branch architectures and CNN-Transformer fusion are widely believed to improve vehicle re-identification (Re-ID) by combining complementary representations. We revisit this for a DINOv3-pretrained backbone. A single DINOv3-pretrained ConvNeXt with a tuned recipe reaches 88.19 mAP on VeRi-Wild Small and 77.47 on Large from visual cues alone, within the combined evaluation and optimization noise of the strongest protocol-verified metadata-dependent multi-branch baseline, and 92.38/83.68 with training-free re-ranking. Using this baseline and retrieval-level branch diagnostics, we ask whether representational diversity still pays at this scale. In our runs, it does not. translated_title: 重新思考基础模型预训练下车辆重识别的多分支与跨骨干网络融合
translated_abstract: 多分支架构与CNN-Transformer融合被广泛认为能够通过结合互补的表示来提升车辆重识别（Re-ID）性能。我们针对DINOv3预训练的骨干网络重新审视了这一观点。单个采用调优训练配方的DINOv3预训练ConvNeXt仅凭视觉线索，就在VeRi-Wild Small上达到88.19 mAP、在Large上达到77.47，处于最强经协议验证的依赖元数据的多分支基线的评估与优化综合噪声范围之内；配合免训练重排序则可达到92.38/83.68。以该基线和检索层面的分支诊断为工具，我们探究在这一规模下表示多样性是否仍然有回报。在我们的实验中，答案是否定的。在两个基准数据集和所有收敛配置中，在共享骨干网络上拼接多个头，使最佳单头的性能在任一方向上的变化都不超过一个mAP点，同时却要付出四倍嵌入维度的代价；拼接表示的99.7%的方差（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现，在DINOv3基础模型预训练时代，单个经过调优的预训练ConvNeXt骨干即可达到甚至超越多分支与跨骨干融合基线的车辆重识别性能，表明多分支表示融合在这一规模下已不再带来实质收益。
en_tdlr: In the era of foundation-model pretraining, a single tuned DINOv3-pretrained ConvNeXt matches or exceeds multi-branch and cross-backbone fusion baselines on vehicle Re-ID, showing that multi-branch representational diversity no longer pays off at this scale.
